name: cortex
description: Durable Cortex control plane for staged agent work: tasks, gates, delegations, locks, and handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate staged work across Codex agents
interface.longDescription: Adds 21 bundled agent profiles, 10 skills, and one unified orchestrate tool over the local Cortex v7 ledger. One call starts a task wave and one call advances each dependent wave while preserving receipt-backed reports, staged gates, knowledge harvests, and source-backed recovery.
interface.defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with Cortex. Use help, harvest, or harvest-refresh when that exact route is requested.
